versions.content: If the switch StbMDevErrorDetect ( ECUC_StbM_00012 : ) is set to TRUE , StbM_BusSetGlobalTime() shall report to DET the development error STBM_E_PARAM_TIMESTAMP , if called with a parameter timeStamp that contains invalid elements (e.g., nanoseconds part > 999999999 ns).
